rules.title: EDD-001 power tree: USB-C VBUS 5V -> SS34 reverse protection -> USB_5V -> AP63203WU-7 buck -> 3V3

constraint.notes: Power path follows the frozen USB contract's declared topology (USB VBUS -> SS34 -> USB_5V -> AP63203WU-7) and is corroborated by the ESP32-S3-LCD-EV-Board reference design at board level (reference-design evidence, not exact-component evidence).

rules.title: 3V3 rail regulator AP63203WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated), TSOT-26, VIN 3.8-32V, fixed 3.3V output, 2A

features: frequency spread spectrum (FSS) for EMI reduction
PFM at light load (up to 80% efficiency at 1mA)
constraint.notes: Rated output is regulator capability, not board-level available current; USB source capability remains externally constrained per frozen POWER_SOURCE_SEPARATION.

rules.title: AP63203 external components per DS41326 Rev. 3-2 typical application: Cin 10uF, Cout 2x22uF, L 4.7uH, CBST 100nF

cin.placement: VIN to GND, close to VIN pin

inductor.dc_current_rating: at least 35% higher than maximum load current

constraint.input_cap_rms_note: input capacitor RMS rating greater than half of the maximum load current, low ESR

module_local_decoupling_retained.requirement: 22uF bulk + 100nF HF at module VDD33 must NOT be removed even though the buck has its own output caps

rules.title: AP63203 EN pin: precision 1.18V threshold for UVLO programming; tie to VIN or leave open for automatic startup

constraint.default_connection: attach to VIN or leave open for automatic startup
constraint.notes: UVLO divider programming is available but not required for v0.1 baseline.

rules.title: USBLC6-2SC6 sits on USB D+/D- series path with VBUS/GND clamp at the connector, not in the 5V power path

constraint.protection_network: D+/D- series path; VBUS and GND clamped
constraint.notes: USBLC6-2SC6 is a USB data-line ESD protector with rail-to-rail clamp; it is not a series element in the VBUS-to-buck power path (W4A evidence-first adjudication).

rules.title: SS34 Schottky (40V, 3A, SMA/DO-214AC) as VBUS reverse-protection diode between USB VBUS and USB_5V

constraint.purpose: prevent back-feed into USB VBUS when other 5V sources are present
constraint.tech_debt: Schottky drop (~0.55V at 3A) reduces available headroom; future high-power revisions may move to ideal-diode/power-path (frozen USB contract tech_debt note)
